wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: Jaguar Cars
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata: Jaguar (UK: , US: ) is the sports car and luxury vehicle brand of Jaguar Land Rover, a British  multinational car manufacturer with its headquarters in Whitley, Coventry, England. Jaguar Cars was the company that was responsible for the production of Jaguar cars until its operations were fully merged with those of Land Rover to form Jaguar Land Rover on 1 January 2013.

wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: Ford GT
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata: The Ford GT is a mid-engine two-seater sports car manufactured and marketed by American automobile manufacturer Ford for the 2005 model year in conjunction with the company's 2003 centenary. The second generation Ford GT became available for the 2017 model year.

wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: Ford F-Series
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata: The Ford F-Series is a series of light-duty trucks marketed and manufactured by the Ford Motor Company since model year 1948 as a range of full-size pickup trucks — positioned between Ford's Ranger and Super Duty pickup trucks. Alongside the F-150 (introduced in 1975), the F-Series also includes the Super Duty series (introduced in 1999), which includes the heavier-duty F-250 through F-450 pickups, F-450/F-550 chassis cabs, and F-600/F-650/F-750 Class 6–8 commercial trucks.

wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: List of best-selling automobiles
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata:
Since the introduction of the Benz Patent Motorwagen in 1886, some passenger cars and light trucks can claim to being the highest selling vehicles in the automobile markets.
While references to verify the manufacturers' claims have been included, there is always the possibility of inaccuracy or hyperbole.

wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: Car
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata: A car, or an automobile, is a motor vehicle with wheels. Most definitions of cars state that they run primarily on roads, seat 1-8 people, have four wheels, and mainly transport people rather than cargo.

wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: Ford Ranger (T6)
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata: The Ford Ranger (T6) is a range of mid-size pickup trucks manufactured and sold by Ford Motor Company since 2011. The T6 consolidated worldwide production of the Ranger onto a single model range, replacing both the 1998–2012 Ranger marketed in North America and South America and the Mazda-derived Ranger sold in Asia-Pacific, Europe, and several Latin American markets.

wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: Ford police vehicles
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata: Ford police vehicles constitute the automobiles manufactured and sold by the Ford Motor Company for use as police cars and other car-based emergency vehicles. Though Ford has been producing police-oriented fleet vehicle variants of their full-size Ford sedans since the 1950s, the primary nameplate used by Ford for police vehicles since 1992 has been the Ford Police Interceptor, consisting of existing Ford models modified and sold for frontline police and emergency service use.

wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.title: Ford F-150 Lightning
wikipedia:Ford F-150 2026 car.metadata: The Ford F-150 Lightning is a battery electric light duty full-size pickup truck unveiled by the Ford Motor Company in May 2021 as part of the fourteenth generation Ford F-Series. Four models have been announced, and all models initially will be dual-motor, four-wheel-drive, with EPA range estimates of 240–320 mi (390–510 km).

wikipedia-title:Honda E.title: Honda e
wikipedia-title:Honda E.metadata: The Honda e is a battery electric car that was manufactured by Japanese automaker Honda and sold in Japan from 2020 to 2024 and in Europe from 2020 to 2023. It is a supermini with a five-door hatchback design and a battery-electric powertrain that drives the rear wheels.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C1.title: Citroën C1

The C1 was developed along with two badge engineered variants, the Peugeot 107, which is mostly identical to the C1 aside from its front bumper fascia and front and rear lights, and the Toyota Aygo, which is slightly more differentiated.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C2.title: Citroën C2
wikipedia-title:Citroen C2.metadata: The Citroën C2 is a supermini car which was made by the French company Citroën from August 2003 until October 2009. It is a three-door hatchback with a front-engine, front-wheel-drive layout and was produced at the  Aulnay factory on the outskirts of Paris.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C3.title: Citroën C3
wikipedia-title:Citroen C3.metadata: The Citroën C3 is a supermini car (B-segment) produced by Citroën since April 2002. It replaced the Citroën Saxo in the model line up, and is currently in its fourth generation.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C4.title: Citroën C4
wikipedia-title:Citroen C4.metadata: The Citroën C4 is a car produced by Citroën, part of Stellantis. It was positioned to be the successor to the Citroën Xsara.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C4 Cactus.title: Citroën C4 Cactus
wikipedia-title:Citroen C4 Cactus.metadata: The Citroën C4 Cactus is a subcompact crossover SUV, produced by French automaker Citroën in Spain between April 2014 and December 2017, with production of the second generation commencing in October 2017 (until May 2020 in Villaverde), with the final months of production being disrupted by the COVID-19 pandemic. The C4 Cactus is considered a compact SUV, although it is based on the PSA PF1 platform that underpins the smaller Citroën C3 and DS3.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C5.title: Citroën C5
wikipedia-title:Citroen C5.metadata: The Citroën C5 is a large family car produced by the French manufacturer Citroën between 2000 and 2018 in France, and between 2008 and 2022 in China, over two generations. It replaced the Citroën Xantia, in the large family car class, and is the first modern Citroën with "Cx" naming nomenclature, previously used by its ancestors, the C4 and C6 from 1930.

wikipedia-title:Citroen DS3.title: DS 3
wikipedia-title:Citroen DS3.metadata: The DS 3 (formerly known as Citroën DS3 and DS 3 Crossback) is a luxury supermini initially produced by the French automobile manufacturer Citroën and officially launched in January 2010. Positioned below the DS 4, this was the first and entry-level model from the DS premium sub-brand (pronounced déesse, which is French for goddess), which was spun-off in 2016 into DS Automobiles.

wikipedia-title:Citroen DS4.title: DS 4
wikipedia-title:Citroen DS4.metadata: The DS 4 is a compact hatchback, and it is the second model in the luxury DS sub-brand created by Citroën, now an independent brand. Starting in 2021, it is currently in its second generation, which is based on an all-new EMP2 platform shared with the Opel Astra L and Peugeot 308 III. As of 2023, it is currently slotted above the DS 3 and below the DS 7 Crossback.

wikipedia-title:Citroen Saxo.title: Citroën Saxo
wikipedia-title:Citroen Saxo.metadata: The Citroën Saxo is a supermini car which was produced by the French manufacturer Citroën from 1996 to 2003. It was sold in Japan as the Citroën Chanson, because Honda had registered the "Saxo" name.

wikipedia-title:Citroen Xsara.title: Citroën Xsara
wikipedia-title:Citroen Xsara.metadata: The Citroën Xsara () is a compact C-segment family car, produced by the French automaker PSA Peugeot Citroën, under their Citroën marque, from 1997 to 2006. The Xsara was a development of the Citroën ZX and Peugeot 306, which shared a platform and running gear.

wikipedia-title:Fiat 500x.title: Fiat 500X
wikipedia-title:Fiat 500x.metadata: The Fiat 500X (Type 334) is a subcompact crossover SUV manufactured and marketed by Stellantis (formerly Fiat Chrysler Automobiles), since its debut at the 2014 Paris Motor Show. Following the 500L, and produced from 2014 (from 2016 model year for US), the 500X is closely related to the Jeep Renegade.

wikipedia-title:Ford KA.title: Ford Ka
wikipedia-title:Ford KA.metadata: The Ford Ka is a small car which was manufactured by Ford Motor Company from 1996 to 2021 over three generations. It entered its second generation in 2008, produced by Fiat in Tychy, Poland.

wikipedia-title:Honda CR V.title: Honda CR-V
wikipedia-title:Honda CR V.metadata: The Honda CR-V (also sold as the Honda Breeze in China since 2019) is a compact crossover SUV manufactured by Japanese automaker Honda since 1995. Initial models of the CR-V were built using the same platform as the Civic.

wikipedia-title:Honda FR V.title: Honda FR-V
wikipedia-title:Honda FR V.metadata: The Honda FR-V, marketed as the Honda Edix in Japan, is a six-passenger car that was manufactured by Honda from 2004 to 2009 (with marketing ending in 2011 in some regions), over a single generation. A five-door compact multi-purpose vehicle (MPV), the FR-V was noted for its 3+3 seating configuration, along with the Fiat Multipla.

wikipedia-title:Honda HR V.title: Honda HR-V
wikipedia-title:Honda HR V.metadata:
The Honda HR-V is a subcompact crossover SUV (B-segment) manufactured and marketed by Honda over three generations.
The first generation HR-V, based on the Honda Logo, was marketed from 1999 to 2006 in Europe, Japan and select Asia-Pacific markets, in either three-door (1999–2003) or five-door (1999–2006) configurations — internally designated GH2 and GH4 respectively.

wikipedia-title:Honda ZR V.title: Honda ZR-V
wikipedia-title:Honda ZR V.metadata: The Honda ZR-V (called the Honda HR-V in North America and China) is a compact crossover SUV (C-segment) produced by Honda. Positioned between the global market HR-V/Vezel/XR-V and the CR-V, the vehicle shares its platform with the eleventh-generation Civic.

wikipedia-title:Jaguar F Pace.title: Jaguar F-Pace
wikipedia-title:Jaguar F Pace.metadata: The Jaguar F-Pace (X761) is a compact luxury crossover SUV that was manufactured by Jaguar Land Rover, a British car manufacturer, under their Jaguar marque. It was the first Jaguar SUV. It was formally announced at the 2015 North American International Auto Show in Detroit, with sales commencing in 2016 following an unveiling at the 2015 International Motor Show Germany in Frankfurt.

wikipedia-title:Jaguar S Type.title: Jaguar S-Type
wikipedia-title:Jaguar S Type.metadata: Jaguar S-Type is the name of two vehicles:

wikipedia-title:Mazda RX 8.title: Mazda RX-8
wikipedia-title:Mazda RX 8.metadata: The Mazda RX-8 is a sports car manufactured by Japanese automobile manufacturer Mazda between 2003 and 2012. It was first shown in 2001 at the North American International Auto Show.

wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz A Class.title: Mercedes-Benz A-Class
wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz A Class.metadata: The Mercedes-Benz A-Class is a car manufactured by German luxury automaker Mercedes-Benz. It has been marketed across four generations as a front-engine, front-wheel drive, five-passenger, five-door hatchback, with a three-door hatchback offered for the second generation, as well as a saloon version for the fourth.

wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz B Class.title: Mercedes-Benz B-Class
wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz B Class.metadata:
The Mercedes-Benz B-Class is a subcompact executive car manufactured and marketed by Mercedes-Benz since 2005. Based on the A-Class with larger dimensions, the European New Car Assessment Programme (Euro NCAP) classifies it as a small MPV.
Mercedes-Benz had presented a concept car Vision B Compact Sports Tourer at the 2004 Paris Motor Show.

wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz C Class.title: Mercedes-Benz C-Class
wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz C Class.metadata: The Mercedes-Benz C-Class is a series of compact executive cars produced by Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Introduced in 1993 as a replacement for the 190 (W201) range, the C-Class was the smallest model in the marque's line-up until the W168 A-Class arrived in 1997. The C-Class has been available with a "4MATIC" four-wheel drive option since 2002.

wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz E Class.title: Mercedes-Benz E-Class
wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz E Class.metadata: The Mercedes-Benz E-Class is a range of executive cars manufactured by German automaker Mercedes-Benz in various engine and body configurations. Produced since September 1953, the E-Class falls as a midrange in the Mercedes line-up, and has been marketed worldwide across five generations.

wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz G Class.title: Mercedes-Benz G-Class
wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz G Class.metadata: The Mercedes-Benz G-Class, colloquially known as the G-Wagon or G-Wagen (as an abbreviation of Geländewagen), is a four-wheel drive luxury SUV sold by Mercedes-Benz. Originally developed as a military off-roader, later more luxurious models were added to the line.

wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz S Class.title: Mercedes-Benz S-Class
wikipedia-title:Mercedes-Benz S Class.metadata: The Mercedes-Benz S-Class, formerly known as "special class" (German: "Sonderklasse", abbreviated as "S-Klasse"), is a series of full-sized luxury sedans and coupés produced by the German automaker Mercedes-Benz. The S-Class is the designation for top-of-the-line Mercedes-Benz models and was officially introduced in 1972 with the W116, and has remained in use ever since.

wikipedia-title:Nissan 370z.title: Nissan 370Z
wikipedia-title:Nissan 370z.metadata: The Nissan 370Z (known as the Fairlady Z Z34 in Japan) is a two-seater sports car which was made by Nissan from 2008 until 2020. Based on the Nissan FM platform, it has a front mid-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout and either a two-door coupé or two-door roadster body style.

wikipedia-title:Nissan GT R.title: Nissan GT-R
wikipedia-title:Nissan GT R.metadata: The Nissan GT-R (Gran Turismo–Racing; model code: R35; Japanese: 日産・GT-R; Nissan GT-R) is a sports car, built by Japanese marque Nissan from 2007 to 2025. It has a 2+2 seating layout and is also considered a grand tourer.

wikipedia-title:Nissan X Trail.title: Nissan X-Trail
wikipedia-title:Nissan X Trail.metadata:
The Nissan X-Trail (Japanese: 日産・エクストレイル, Hepburn: Nissan Ekusutoreiru) is a compact crossover SUV produced by the Japanese automaker Nissan since 2000, replacing the Rasheen and Terrano II. Since 2018, it is positioned between the Qashqai and the larger Murano.
Since the third-generation model, the X-Trail became the same vehicle as the North American market Rogue.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Enyaq.title: Škoda Enyaq
wikipedia-title:Škoda Enyaq.metadata: The Škoda Enyaq (originally introduced as Škoda Enyaq iV) is a battery electric compact crossover SUV manufactured by Škoda Auto. It was introduced in September 2020 in Prague, while mass production commenced in November 2020.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Fabia.title: Škoda Fabia
wikipedia-title:Škoda Fabia.metadata: The Škoda Fabia is a series of passenger cars produced by Czech manufacturer Škoda Auto since 1999. It is the successor of the Škoda Felicia, which was discontinued in 2001.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Octavia.title: Škoda Octavia
wikipedia-title:Škoda Octavia.metadata: The Škoda Octavia is a small family car (C-segment) produced by the Czech car manufacturer Škoda Auto since the end of 1996. It shares its name with an earlier model produced between 1959 and 1971.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Octavia Combi.title: Škoda Octavia
wikipedia-title:Škoda Octavia Combi.metadata: The Škoda Octavia is a small family car (C-segment) produced by the Czech car manufacturer Škoda Auto since the end of 1996. It shares its name with an earlier model produced between 1959 and 1971.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Rapid.title: Škoda Rapid
wikipedia-title:Škoda Rapid.metadata: Škoda Rapid is a name used by the Czech automotive company Škoda Auto, on several different models of car:

wikipedia-title:Škoda Roomster.title: Škoda Roomster
wikipedia-title:Škoda Roomster.metadata: The Škoda Roomster (Type 5J) is a small family car manufactured and marketed by Škoda Auto from December 2005 to 2015 over a single generation with a single intermediate facelift. It has a five-door, five passenger, front-engine, front-wheel drive, high-roof design and has been described as a hatchback, an estate car, or a multi-purpose vehicle.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Scala.title: Škoda Scala
wikipedia-title:Škoda Scala.metadata: The Škoda Scala is a small family car or compact hatchback (C-segment) manufactured by Czech automaker Škoda Auto. The car is intended to fit between the Fabia and the Octavia, and to be a competitor to the cars in the C-segment hatchback segment.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Superb.title: Škoda Superb
wikipedia-title:Škoda Superb.metadata: The Škoda Superb is a mid-size/large family car/compact executive car (D-segment) that has been produced by the Czech car manufacturer Škoda Auto since 2001. The first generation of the modern Superb, produced from 2001 to 2008, was based on the VW B5 PL45+ platform.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Yeti.title: Škoda Yeti
wikipedia-title:Škoda Yeti.metadata: The Škoda Yeti (codenamed Typ 5L) is a compact crossover SUV produced by the Czech car manufacturer Škoda Auto and introduced at the 2009 Geneva Motor Show, as the carmaker's first entry into the SUV market. In 2009, the Yeti was awarded Family Car of the Year by Top Gear Magazine.

wikipedia-title:Toyota Rav4.title: Toyota RAV4
wikipedia-title:Toyota Rav4.metadata: The Toyota RAV4 (Japanese: トヨタ・RAV4, Hepburn: Toyota Ravufō) is a compact crossover SUV produced by the Japanese automobile manufacturer Toyota. Having sold over 15 million units worldwide as of 2025, the RAV4 is the best-selling SUV of all time.

wikipedia-title:Alfa Romeo Mito.title: Alfa Romeo MiTo
wikipedia-title:Alfa Romeo Mito.metadata: The Alfa Romeo MiTo (Type 955) is a supermini car which was made by Fiat Group Automobiles from 2008 until 2020 and sold under the Alfa Romeo marque. It is a three-door hatchback with a front-engine, front-wheel-drive layout and shares its SCCS platform with the Fiat Grande Punto.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Kamiq.title: Škoda Kamiq
wikipedia-title:Škoda Kamiq.metadata: The Škoda Kamiq is a subcompact crossover SUV (B-segment) produced by the Czech car manufacturer Škoda Auto since 2019. It is smallest of the Škoda SUVs, namely the Karoq, Enyaq, and Kodiaq.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Karoq.title: Škoda Karoq
wikipedia-title:Škoda Karoq.metadata: The Škoda Karoq is a compact crossover SUV (C-segment) designed and built by the Czech car manufacturer Škoda Auto. Introduced in 2017, the vehicle is based on the Volkswagen Group MQB A1 platform, and since replaced the Škoda Yeti.

wikipedia-title:Kia Xceed.title: Kia Ceed
wikipedia-title:Kia Xceed.metadata:
The Kia Ceed (known as the Kia Cee'd before 2018) is a compact car/small family car (C-segment) produced by the South Korean manufacturer Kia From 2006 exclusively for the European market.
It is the first Kia vehicle to be designed entirely in Europe and tailored to European customers.

wikipedia-title:Škoda Kodiaq.title: Škoda Kodiaq
wikipedia-title:Škoda Kodiaq.metadata: The Škoda Kodiaq is a mid-size crossover SUV with optional three-row seating manufactured by the Czech manufacturer Škoda Auto since 2016. The vehicle sits in Škoda's D-SUV, above the Kamiq and Karoq.

wikipedia-title:Toyota C HR.title: Toyota C-HR
wikipedia-title:Toyota C HR.metadata: The Toyota C-HR (Japanese: トヨタ C-HR, Hepburn: Toyota Shīeichiāru) is a subcompact crossover SUV manufactured and marketed by Japanese automaker Toyota since 2016. Since 2020, it is positioned between the Yaris Cross and Corolla Cross in Toyota's crossover SUV range.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C3 Aircross.title: Citroën C3 Aircross
wikipedia-title:Citroen C3 Aircross.metadata:
The Citroën C3 Aircross is a nameplate designated to several vehicles produced under the Citroën marque, by the French automaker PSA Group, and later Stellantis.
The first vehicle using the nameplate was the Brazilian version of the C3 Picasso MPV, decorated to mimic an SUV exterior design, which was produced between 2010 and 2020.

wikipedia-title:Citroen C5 Aircross.title: Citroën C5 Aircross
wikipedia-title:Citroen C5 Aircross.metadata: The Citroën C5 Aircross is a compact crossover SUV produced by the French automaker Citroën since 2017. The first generation model was previewed by the Concept Citroën Aircross concept car which was unveiled at the 2015 Shanghai Auto Show.

wikipedia-title:Ford Mustang Mach E.title: Ford Mustang Mach-E
wikipedia-title:Ford Mustang Mach E.metadata: The Ford Mustang Mach-E is a battery electric compact crossover SUV produced by Ford. Introduced on November 17, 2019, it went on sale in December 2020 as a 2021 model.

wikipedia-title:Volkswagen ID 4.title: Volkswagen ID.4
wikipedia-title:Volkswagen ID 4.metadata: The Volkswagen ID.4 and Volkswagen ID.5 are battery electric compact crossover SUVs produced by Volkswagen. Based on the MEB platform, the ID.4 is the second model of the Volkswagen ID. series.

wikipedia-title:Volkswagen ID 5.title: Volkswagen ID.4
wikipedia-title:Volkswagen ID 5.metadata: The Volkswagen ID.4 and Volkswagen ID.5 are battery electric compact crossover SUVs produced by Volkswagen. Based on the MEB platform, the ID.4 is the second model of the Volkswagen ID. series.

wikipedia-title:Volkswagen ID 7.title: Volkswagen ID.7
wikipedia-title:Volkswagen ID 7.metadata: The Volkswagen ID.7 is a battery electric car produced by German marque Volkswagen since 2023. It has a five-door liftback design and is marketed in the E-segment.

wikipedia-title:Mercedes-AMG One.title: Mercedes-AMG One
wikipedia-title:Mercedes-AMG One.metadata: The Mercedes-AMG One (R50, previously known as Project One) is a limited-production plug-in dual hybrid sports car manufactured by Mercedes-AMG, featuring Formula One–derived technology. The Project One concept car was unveiled at the 2017 International Motor Show Germany by then three-time Formula One World Drivers' Champion and Mercedes driver Lewis Hamilton and head of Mercedes-Benz, Dieter Zetsche.

wikipedia-title:Opel Corsa E.title: Opel Corsa
wikipedia-title:Opel Corsa E.metadata: The Opel Corsa is a supermini car manufactured and marketed by Opel since 1982. The car is known as the Vauxhall Corsa in the United Kingdom.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: Chevrolet
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: Chevrolet is an American automobile division of the manufacturer General Motors (GM). In North America, Chevrolet produces and sells a wide range of vehicles, from subcompact automobiles to medium-duty commercial trucks.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: Chevrolet Corvette
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: The Chevrolet Corvette is a line of American two-door, two-seater sports cars manufactured and marketed by General Motors under the Chevrolet marque since 1953. Throughout eight generations, indicated sequentially as C1 to C8, the Corvette is noted for its performance, distinctive styling, lightweight fiberglass or composite bodywork, and competitive pricing.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: General Motors LS-based small-block engine
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: The General Motors LS-based small-block engines are a family of V8 and offshoot V6 engines designed and manufactured by the American automotive company General Motors. Introduced in 1997, the family is a continuation of the earlier first- and second-generation Chevrolet small-block engine, of which over 100 million have been produced and is also considered one of the most popular V8 engines ever.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: LA Auto Show
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: The Los Angeles Auto Show, also known as the LA Auto Show, is an auto show held annually at the Los Angeles Convention Center in Los Angeles, California, United States. It is open to the public for ten days, filling 760,000 square feet (71,000 m2) of exhibit space.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: Chevrolet Corvette (C3)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: The Chevrolet Corvette (C3) is the third generation of the Corvette sports car that was produced from 1967 until 1982 by Chevrolet for the 1968 to 1982 model years. Engines and chassis components were mostly carried over from the previous generation, but the body and interior were new.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: Chevrolet Camaro (fifth generation)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: The fifth-generation Chevrolet Camaro is a pony car that was manufactured by American automobile manufacturer Chevrolet from 2010 to 2015 model years. It is the fifth distinct generation of the muscle/pony car to be produced since its original introduction in 1967.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: Chevrolet Camaro (fourth generation)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: The fourth-generation Chevrolet Camaro, colloquially known as the "Catfish Camaro", is a pony car that was produced by American automobile manufacturer General Motors for the 1993 through 2002 model years. It was introduced on an updated F-body platform but retained characteristics of the first-generation car introduced in 1967: two doors, coupe or convertible bodystyles, rear-wheel drive, and a choice of 6-cylinder and V8 engines.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.title: Chevrolet Corvette (C7)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 2017 Wi.metadata: The Chevrolet Corvette (C7) is the seventh generation of the Corvette sports car manufactured by American automobile manufacturer Chevrolet from 2014 until 2019. The first C7 Corvettes were delivered in the third quarter of 2013.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: Chevrolet
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: Chevrolet is an American automobile division of the manufacturer General Motors (GM). In North America, Chevrolet produces and sells a wide range of vehicles, from subcompact automobiles to medium-duty commercial trucks.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: Chevrolet Corvette
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: The Chevrolet Corvette is a line of American two-door, two-seater sports cars manufactured and marketed by General Motors under the Chevrolet marque since 1953. Throughout eight generations, indicated sequentially as C1 to C8, the Corvette is noted for its performance, distinctive styling, lightweight fiberglass or composite bodywork, and competitive pricing.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: General Motors LS-based small-block engine
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: The General Motors LS-based small-block engines are a family of V8 and offshoot V6 engines designed and manufactured by the American automotive company General Motors. Introduced in 1997, the family is a continuation of the earlier first- and second-generation Chevrolet small-block engine, of which over 100 million have been produced and is also considered one of the most popular V8 engines ever.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: Chevrolet Corvette (C3)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: The Chevrolet Corvette (C3) is the third generation of the Corvette sports car that was produced from 1967 until 1982 by Chevrolet for the 1968 to 1982 model years. Engines and chassis components were mostly carried over from the previous generation, but the body and interior were new.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: List of Chevrolet vehicles
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: Chevrolet is a division of the manufacturer General Motors (GM), which produces vehicles since 1911 worldwide.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: Chevrolet Camaro (fifth generation)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: The fifth-generation Chevrolet Camaro is a pony car that was manufactured by American automobile manufacturer Chevrolet from 2010 to 2015 model years. It is the fifth distinct generation of the muscle/pony car to be produced since its original introduction in 1967.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: Chevrolet Corvette (C7)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: The Chevrolet Corvette (C7) is the seventh generation of the Corvette sports car manufactured by American automobile manufacturer Chevrolet from 2014 until 2019. The first C7 Corvettes were delivered in the third quarter of 2013.

wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.title: Chevrolet Corvette (C8)
wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 car.metadata: The Chevrolet Corvette (C8) is the eighth generation of the Corvette sports car manufactured by American automobile manufacturer Chevrolet. It is the first rear mid-engine Corvette since the model's introduction in 1953, differing from the traditional front mid-engine design started in 1963.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata: Citroën (French: [sitʁɔɛn] ) is a French automobile brand owned by Stellantis since 2021. The "Automobiles Citroën" manufacturing company was founded on 4 June 1919 by André Citroën.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën 2CV
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata: The Citroën 2CV (French: deux chevaux, pronounced [dø ʃ(ə)vo], lit. "two horses", meaning "two taxable horsepower") is an economy car produced by the French company Citroën from 1948 to 1990.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën SM
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata: The Citroën SM is a high-performance coupé produced by the French manufacturer Citroën from 1970 to 1975.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën DS
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata:
The Citroën DS (French pronunciation: [si.tʁɔ.ɛn de.ɛs]) is a front mid-engined, front-wheel drive executive car manufactured and marketed by Citroën from 1955 to 1975, in fastback/sedan, wagon/estate, and convertible body configurations, across a single generation comprising three series.
Marketed with a less expensive variant, the Citroën ID, the DS was known for its aerodynamic, futuristic body design; unorthodox, quirky, and innovative technology.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën C2
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata: The Citroën C2 is a supermini car which was made by the French company Citroën from August 2003 until October 2009. It is a three-door hatchback with a front-engine, front-wheel-drive layout and was produced at the  Aulnay factory on the outskirts of Paris.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën C4
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata: The Citroën C4 is a car produced by Citroën, part of Stellantis. It was positioned to be the successor to the Citroën Xsara.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën C4 Cactus
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata: The Citroën C4 Cactus is a subcompact crossover SUV, produced by French automaker Citroën in Spain between April 2014 and December 2017, with production of the second generation commencing in October 2017 (until May 2020 in Villaverde), with the final months of production being disrupted by the COVID-19 pandemic. The C4 Cactus is considered a compact SUV, although it is based on the PSA PF1 platform that underpins the smaller Citroën C3 and DS3.

wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.title: Citroën DS3 R5
wikipedia:Citroën DS3 2017 Wikimedia Com.metadata: The Citroën DS3 R5 is a R5 rally car built by Citroën Racing, the motorsport division of the French automobile manufacturer Citroën, based upon the Citroën DS3 road car. The car was specifically developed for entry in the WRC-2 category of the World Rally Championship, and made its WRC debut at the 2014 Rally Italia Sardegna.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.title: Fiat S.p.A.
wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.metadata:
Fiat S.p.A., commonly known as Fiat Group, was an Italian holding company whose original and core activities were in the automotive industry.
The Fiat Group contained many brands such as Fiat, Abarth, Ferrari, Maserati, Lancia and Alfa Romeo.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.title: Fiat Strada
wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.metadata: The Fiat Strada is a coupé utility produced by the Italian manufacturer Fiat since 1998. It is mainly produced in Brazil and marketed throughout Latin America, whereas the first-generation Strada was also assembled in South Africa and exported to Europe from Brazil.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.title: Automotive industry in Italy
wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.metadata: The automotive industry in Italy is a large employer in the country, it had over 2,131 firms and employed almost 250,000 people in 2006. Italy's automotive industry is best known for its automobile designs and small city cars, sports and supercars.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.title: Fiat Linea
wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.metadata: The Fiat Linea (Type 323) is a compact sedan produced by Fiat between 2006 and 2018. The sedan was released on 26 March 2007 at the Tofaş plant in Bursa, Turkey as a "world car" in developing countries.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.title: Fiat
wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.metadata:
Fiat Automobiles S.p.A., commonly known as Fiat (UK:  FEE-ət, -⁠at, US:  -⁠aht; Italian: [ˈfiːat]), is an Italian automobile manufacturer.
Fiat Automobiles was formed in January 2007 when Fiat Group reorganized its automobile business, and traces its history back to 1899, when the first Fiat automobile, the Fiat 4 HP, was produced.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.title: FCA India Automobiles
wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.metadata: FCA India Automobiles Private Limited (FCAIPL), formerly known as Fiat Group Automobiles India Private Limited, is the Indian subsidiary of Stellantis, formed in 1997. The company was established for the production of cars and engines under the Fiat, Abarth, and Jeep brands.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.title: Fiat Grande Panda
wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2026 car.metadata: The FIAT Grande Panda is a supermini car produced by FIAT since January 2025. It is based on the Smart Car platform shared with the fourth-generation Citroën C3 and Opel Frontera, and is available as a petrol, mild hybrid, or as a battery-electric vehicle.

wikipedia:Fiat Grande Punto 2017 Wikimed.title: Fiat Palio
